Resolves #18760

Builds on #18765 (#18759, merged); rebuilt onto `dev` at `99ebfde7d8` with only this ticket's commit.

The keyboard walks the menu cascade again, inside the focus model the operator ruled for (arrows move focus; Enter, Space and click activate). Right on a focused parent shows its submenu and focuses the first item, including when a hover already shows it. Left and Escape in a submenu hide that level and put focus back on the item that opened it. Space activates the focused item like Enter, and on a menu item it no longer scrolls the page.

Evidence: L3 (component specs drive the real keyboard in Chromium) → L3 required (AC-1…AC-6). No residual.

## AC Evidence

| AC-1 | component `menu/List.spec.mjs` › keyboard cascade › *Right and Left walk two levels down and back up…* + *Right on a leaf, Left in the root, and Down onto a parent show nothing* |
| AC-2 | same two arms |
| AC-3 | same › *Escape in a submenu hides only that level and focuses its parent item; in the root it dismisses* — opens with Enter, so it witnesses Escape alone |
| AC-4 | same › *Space on a parent enters its submenu, and Space on a leaf dismisses like Enter* + *Space on an embedded menu's item scrolls nothing* |
| AC-5 | same › *Right on a leaf, Left in the root, and Down onto a parent show nothing* |
| AC-6 | same › *Right and Left walk two levels down and back up, with focus on the expected item at every step* |
| AC-7 | CI `unit` + `components` |

## Deltas from ticket

- **Space no longer scrolls the page from a menu item.** `main.DomEvents#onKeyDown` suppresses Space's default on a `neo-menu-list` path. The existing arrow rule leaves Space to native interactive targets, and a menu item is not one. Measured: an embedded menu scrolled the page 680 px per Space. A floating menu is `position: fixed` and never reached the scroller, which is why the first version of this arm could not fail.
- The Space binding is menu-local (`selection.menu.ListModel#register`). The Navigator turns Enter into a main-thread click; Space replays that click's two halves in the worker, in listener order: item handling, then selection.

## Test Evidence

Controls at one head, with `src/menu/List.mjs` and `src/selection/menu/ListModel.mjs` from #18759:

| arm | on #18759's sources |
|---|---|
| walk | red at the first Right: expected 2 menus, received 1 |
| Space | red at the first Space: expected 2 menus, received 1 |
| Escape (opened with Enter) | red at Escape: focus lost, `null` instead of `Inspect` |
| nothing opens | green, as a guard against over-eager opening should be |
| embedded Space scroll (rule removed from `main.DomEvents`) | red: `scrollTop` 680; its CONTROL asserts the page can scroll |

Locally, on the rebuilt head: menu/list/selection unit 106/106; menu and tab component 38/38.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Documented search — the three ways this shape usually breaks, and why none of them does here:**

**1. A synthesized call that is lossier than the real one.** `onKeyDownSpace` fabricates two calls. `onListClick({currentTarget})` destructures **only** `currentTarget`, so `{currentTarget: item.id}` supplies exactly what it reads — not a stub that happens to work today. And `list/Base.mjs:791` selects its `item` by `item.cls.includes(me.itemCls)`, while `getKeyItem` routes through `getInteractiveItemIndex`, which applies that same check **plus** the `nonInteractiveItemCls` exclusion. So the keyboard path is faithful and, on separators, slightly stricter than the mouse path. Verified at both sites, not inferred from the docblock.

**2. A main-thread guard escaping its scope.** The new `preventDefault` is gated `!isInput && event.key === ' ' && me.testPathInclusion(event, ['neo-menu-list'])`. Space outside a menu is untouched, and inputs are excluded by the existing predicate it sits beside.

**3. A build dependency that is not on `dev` yet.** `getKeyItem` calls `getInteractiveItemIndex`, which arrives with #18765. That PR merged at `2026-09-16T09:28:28Z`, this branch carries a single commit against `origin/dev` (`99ebfde7d8`, no #18759 commits replayed), and the helper is present at `origin/dev`. So this is a clean independent review, not a stacked one — worth stating because the A2A history describes the pair as stacked and a reader could scope the review wrongly on that basis.

**Challenge (non-blocking) — a cross-thread rule expressed as a string literal.** `'neo-menu-list'` in `main/DomEvents.mjs` is `menu.List#baseCls[0]`, and nothing structurally ties them: main cannot import an app-worker class's config. That is the same drift class this repo already named and fixed once — the `nonInteractiveItemCls` extraction, which #18765 consolidated three days of work into. **It is pinned, though, and that is why it is not a required action:** your *"Space on an embedded menu's item scrolls nothing"* arm locates the menu by `.neo-menu-list`, so a `baseCls` rename reds the arm before it can silently un-gate the guard. Worth a sentence at the `DomEvents` site naming what the literal mirrors, whenever that file is next touched.

**Nit:** `leaveSubMenu()`'s comment — *"showSubMenu() aligns a submenu to the item that opened it, so its target is that item's node id"* — is now the second copy of that sentence in `menu/List.mjs`; `afterSetMounted` carries the first from #18765. One fact, two places, in one file.

The half I would point another reviewer at is the scroll control. A `preventDefault` test that asserts "nothing scrolled" is the easiest vacuous pass in the catalogue — a page with no overflow satisfies it forever. Establishing `scrollable === 10` first converts the assertion from an absence into a measurement, and it is the same discipline as the sibling PR's *"the path really crosses a sibling"* witness. Two different beats, same instinct.
